system.name: Community Resource Referral Assistant
system.workflow: Optional shortlist of public community-resource categories for navigator review

purpose.legitimate_purpose: Help a community navigator identify potentially relevant public resource categories from information voluntarily provided during the current session.
purpose.authority: The community organization may provide informational referrals; it may not determine eligibility, enroll a person, or deny a service.
purpose.intended_benefit: Reduce time spent searching a public directory while preserving navigator review and the person's choice.
excluded_uses: Sharing session information with a provider without the person's choice

evidence.claim: The person asked for food and transportation resources in the current session.
evidence.source: Information voluntarily entered by the person in the current session
evidence.limitations: Needs may be incomplete or may change.
evidence.corroboration: Navigator confirms the request before using the shortlist.

evidence.claim: The listed categories exist in the current public resource directory.
evidence.limitations: A category does not guarantee availability or eligibility.
evidence.corroboration: Navigator opens the current provider page before sharing a referral.

uncertainty: Current provider capacity is not known until the navigator checks the provider page.
The session may not capture accessibility, language, or scheduling needs.

options.description: Use the existing public directory without AI assistance.
options.expected_benefit: Established process with no model-generated shortlist.
options.foreseeable_harm: Longer search time and possible omission due to directory complexity.

options.description: Generate a category shortlist for navigator review, show limitations, and let the person choose whether to receive referrals.
options.expected_benefit: Faster navigation with qualified human verification and user choice.
options.foreseeable_harm: A relevant category could be missed or an irrelevant category could burden the person.

options.description: Automatically select a provider and submit the person's information.
options.expected_benefit: Fewer steps if every assumption is correct.
options.foreseeable_harm: Loss of choice, privacy disclosure, incorrect referral, or implied eligibility.

selected_action: Provide a clearly labeled category shortlist to a trained navigator; require navigator verification and the person's affirmative choice before sharing any provider link.

categories: Broad location supplied for directory filtering
Accessibility or language preference supplied for referral use
data_minimization.retention: Delete session content within 24 hours; retain only aggregate pilot metrics without session text.
access_roles: Pilot safety lead for access-controlled incident review

conditions: Navigator must verify current provider information

agency.notice: The interface states that AI suggests categories and that a human navigator verifies any referral.
agency.human_alternative: The person may ask the navigator to use the public directory without AI assistance.
agency.correction: The person may edit or withdraw session information before any referral is shared.
agency.appeal: A pilot supervisor reviews complaints and can correct the record or referral process.

safeguards: No automatic eligibility, enrollment, denial, or provider contact
Navigator verification before a provider link is shared
Immediate pause if private session content appears in aggregate reporting

monitoring.metric: Navigator-verified relevant-category recall on reviewed synthetic and consented pilot cases
monitoring.stop_threshold: Below 80% or one missed urgent safety referral

monitoring.metric: Availability of a human directory alternative
monitoring.warning_threshold: Any confirmed interface path where the alternative is unclear
monitoring.stop_threshold: Any confirmed case where the person cannot access the alternative
